title: Vintage Weller Sabre Saw Model 88, 120V - Tested & Working
descriptionText:
Up for sale is a vintage Weller Sabre Saw Model 88, manufactured by Weller Tool Corp. in Bayamon, Puerto Rico, USA. This saw is a solid piece of American tool history, known for its durability and reliable performance.

Details:

Brand: Weller
Model: 88
Voltage: 120V
Amperage: 4.8 Amps
Frequency: 60 Hz (AC only)
Origin: Made in USA (Bayamon, PR / Easton, PA)
Condition: Used – Tested and works. Some cosmetic wear from age, but power cord is intact and functional. Please see all photos for actual condition.
Features:
Classic on/off switch
Heavy-duty construction
Original two-prong plug
Whether you're a collector of vintage tools or just looking for a rugged sabre saw with history, this is a great find.
